structured_output.title: Helm-based cert-manager install already past last OperatorHub release
structured_output.content: The change only matters to installs that come from OperatorHub packages, and the evidence says v1.16.5 is the last release published there. This environment already runs cert-manager v1.17.0, which is newer than v1.16.5, and every install source the environment lists is a Helm chart: flux-helmrelease (chart cert-manager), argocd-application (chart cert-manager), helm-annotation (chart cert-manager-v1.17.0) and helmfile (chart jetstack/cert-manager). The manifest apiVersions shown (/v1 Namespace, apps/v1 Deployment, argoproj.io/v1alpha1 Application, cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2 HelmRelease) contain no OperatorHub or OLM resource. The crds dimension is marked absent, so if any cluster also installs cert-manager through OperatorHub, the operator should check that separately.
